name: Park Hyatt Melbourne
positioning: Park Hyatt hotel in central Melbourne overlooking St. Patrick's Cathedral and Fitzroy Gardens, with art deco-inspired rooms, a spa and a heated pool
best_for: Travelers who want spacious rooms near Fitzroy Gardens and the Melbourne Cricket Ground
Spa-goers who want facials, massages and a steam room on site

facts.text: Park Hyatt Melbourne overlooks St. Patrick's Cathedral and Fitzroy Gardens.
Fitzroy Gardens is two minutes from the hotel's doorstep.
The hotel is situated minutes from the Melbourne Cricket Ground and Rod Laver Arena.
Parliament Train Station is a three-minute walk from the hotel.
Rooms and suites blend art deco elegance with modern comfort, featuring wood-panelled walls.
Guest rooms have a separate walk-in shower and deep soaking tub.
Standard rooms feature marble bathtubs, Le Labo toiletries and walk-in closets.
The spa offers facials and massages plus hair and nail services.
The health club has a steam room, and the spa's signature treatment is a coconut body treatment.
radii Restaurant serves a breakfast buffet and a la carte dishes such as Dutch Baby pancakes.
radii Bar serves handcrafted cocktails, fine wines and premium spirits.
The hotel has a resident dog named Charlie.

highlights.text: The lead-in guest rooms measure 48 square meters (517 square feet).
The heated pool sits beneath an Italian mosaic, with an adjoining sundeck.
The spa is on the 9th floor with six treatment spaces, including a couple's suite.
The Terrace Suite has an outdoor terrace with views of St. Patrick's Cathedral and a living room with a fireplace.
Dogs are welcome, and each dog receives a plush bed, food and water bowls and a welcome treat.

considerations.text: Check-in is at 3:00 PM and checkout at 11:00 AM.
WhataHotel notes limited parking availability in the CBD location; the hotel offers valet parking 24 hours for guests.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Park Hyatt Melbourne
